theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  · exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  · cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_I _⟩
    case red_I => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    case par c d hc hd => cases hc; exact ⟨_, hd, .red_I _⟩
  · cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_K _ _⟩
    case red_K => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    case par c d hc hd =>
      rcases Ka_irreducible _ _ hc with ⟨_, hz, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨_, hz, .red_K ..⟩
  · cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .red_S _ _ _⟩
    case red_S => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .refl _⟩
    case par c d hc hd =>
      rcases Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hc with ⟨_, _, hu, hv, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨_, .par (.par hu hd) (.par hv hd), .red_S ..⟩
  case par p q r s hp hq ip iq =>
    cases h₂
    case refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par hp hq⟩
    case red_I => cases hp; exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hq⟩
    case red_K =>
      rcases Ka_irreducible _ _ hp with ⟨_, hz, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨_, .red_K .., hz⟩
    case red_S =>
      rcases Sab_irreducible _ _ _ hp with ⟨_, _, hu, hv, rfl⟩
      exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par hu hq) (.par hv hq)⟩
    case par c d hc hd =>
      rcases ip hc with ⟨_, hx, hx'⟩
      rcases iq hd with ⟨_, hy, hy'⟩
      exact ⟨_, .par hx hy, .par hx' hy'⟩

  ParallelReduction.rec (motive := fun {a a₁} h₁ => ∀ {a₂ : SKI}, a ⭢ₚ a₂ → Join ParallelReduction a₁ a₂)
    (fun a {a₂} h₂ => Exists.intro a₂ ⟨h₂, ParallelReduction.refl a₂⟩)

        (fun a_1 h =>
          Eq.ndrec (motive := fun a_2 => a₂ = a_2 → h₂ ≍ ParallelReduction.refl a_2 → Join ParallelReduction a a₂)

/-- The key result: the Church-Rosser property holds for `⭢ₚ`. The proof is a lengthy case analysis
on the reductions `a ⭢ₚ a₁` and `a ⭢ₚ a₂`, but is entirely mechanical.
-/
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction :=
  by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
